source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The Chaos Vindicator can aim its demolisher cannon at an enemy in its [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range). While any enemy unit is within that range, the Vindicator makes ranged attacks without the corresponding [Hit-roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) penalty.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 9 of 157 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.recipient: enemy unit in the Vindicator’s Engagement Range

effects.appliesTo: all ranged attacks from the Vindicator
effects.when: one or more enemy units within its Engagement Range
